skin-femiwiki-page-menu-tooltip: Tooltip for button used to expand/collapse menu of a page
skin-femiwiki-toc-top: Label of the first entry of the table of contents, which goes back to the top of the page.
skin-femiwiki-toc-close: Tooltip for the button that closes the table of contents drawer on narrow screens.
skin-femiwiki-pin-hide: Tooltip and label of the icon button that folds the table of contents, or a gadget's column on the right, into the drawer.
skin-femiwiki-pin-show: Tooltip and label of the icon button in the drawer that puts the table of contents, or a gadget's column, back beside the content.
skin-femiwiki-search-close: Label and tooltip of the back button in the full-screen search on phones.
skin-femiwiki-share-tooltip: Tooltip for button to share a article
skin-femiwiki-share-dismiss: Label for share dialog dismiss button
skin-femiwiki-share-twitter: Label for button that posts to Twitter
prefs-femiwiki-large-elements-label: Label for the checkbox to enable larger elements via Special:Preferences.
prefs-femiwiki-large-elements-help: Detail explaining the operation of the prefs-femiwiki-large-elements-label checkbox.
skin-femiwiki-special-nav-label: Heading of the list of links between related special pages, such as the watchlist and the page to edit it, and label of the button that opens it on narrow screens.
skin-femiwiki-special-nav-close: Tooltip for the button that closes the drawer of links between related special pages on narrow screens.
